# International Computer Exchange

International Computer Exchange (ICE) is an enterprise IT managed services provider and an IBM Business Partner since 1990. From SOC-audited data centers, ICE delivers managed cloud hosting, disaster recovery, backup, IBM i security, and managed security services to enterprises that run mission-critical workloads on IBM Power Systems and IBM i (AS/400), as well as Microsoft and hybrid environments. The company is headquartered in Boca Raton, Florida, and specializes in high-availability infrastructure, business continuity, and ransomware resilience for regulated and uptime-sensitive organizations.

This file is a machine-readable directory of ICE's services and company information for large language models and AI answer engines. All URLs are canonical and English-only.

## Services

### Managed Cloud Services
- [Managed Cloud Hosting](https://icesales.com/solutions/managed-cloud-hosting): Fully managed enterprise cloud hosting on IBM Power and x86 infrastructure with 24/7 monitoring and support from SOC-audited data centers.
- [Managed Private Cloud](https://icesales.com/solutions/managed-private-cloud): Single-tenant private cloud with dedicated compute and storage for workloads needing maximum isolation, control, and compliance.
- [Managed Hybrid Cloud](https://icesales.com/solutions/managed-hybrid-cloud): Unified hybrid cloud bridging on-premises IBM Power and Microsoft systems with ICE-hosted cloud for elastic capacity and DR.
- [Cloud Migration Services](https://icesales.com/solutions/cloud-migration): Expert-led migration of IBM i, AIX, and Windows workloads to managed cloud with minimal downtime and validated cutover.

### Managed Data Protection
- [Backup as a Service](https://icesales.com/solutions/backup-as-a-service): Automated, encrypted enterprise backup with offsite replication and tested, guaranteed restores for IBM i, AIX, and Windows.
- [Disaster Recovery as a Service](https://icesales.com/solutions/disaster-recovery): Managed DRaaS for IBM Power and Microsoft workloads with defined RPO/RTO targets and regular recovery testing.
- [High Availability as a Service](https://icesales.com/solutions/high-availability): Continuous replication, clustering, and automated failover to maximize uptime for IBM i and mission-critical systems.
- [Ransomware Recovery](https://icesales.com/solutions/ransomware-recovery): Air-gapped, immutable backups and a rehearsed recovery runbook for rapid restoration after a ransomware attack.

### Managed Security
- [IBM i Security](https://icesales.com/solutions/ibm-i-security): Hardening, access control, exit-point protection, and compliance auditing purpose-built for the IBM i (AS/400) platform.
- [Protection Suite](https://icesales.com/solutions/protection-suite): Layered endpoint and network protection combining anti-malware, encryption, and policy enforcement across the enterprise.
- [Security Monitoring](https://icesales.com/solutions/security-monitoring): 24/7 security monitoring, log analysis, and incident response for continuous visibility into enterprise infrastructure.
- [Threat Detection and Response](https://icesales.com/solutions/threat-detection): Real-time threat detection and coordinated response to identify, contain, and remediate active security incidents.
- [Endpoint Security](https://icesales.com/solutions/endpoint-security): Centralized endpoint protection and management securing servers, workstations, and remote devices at scale.

### Managed Services
- [Managed Microsoft Services](https://icesales.com/solutions/managed-microsoft): End-to-end management of Microsoft 365, Azure, and Windows Server environments with monitoring, patching, and support.
- [Automation Suite](https://icesales.com/solutions/automation-suite): Operational automation for scheduling, monitoring, and routine IT tasks to reduce manual effort and error across systems.
- [Systems Management](https://icesales.com/solutions/systems-management): Proactive management, patching, and performance tuning of IBM Power, IBM i, and enterprise server infrastructure.
- [IBM Power VS](https://icesales.com/solutions/ibm-power-vs): Managed IBM Power Virtual Server (Power VS) deployments delivering scalable IBM i and AIX capacity on IBM Cloud.
